chk_invoices_issued.name: chk_invoices_issued
chk_invoices_issued.value:
"invoices"."status" = 'borrador' or (
        "invoices"."invoice_number" is not null and "invoices"."exchange_rate_micros" is not null
        and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null and "invoices"."pdf_path" is not null) or (
        "invoices"."status" = 'anulada' and "invoices"."invoice_number" is null)

chk_invoices_status_balance.name: chk_invoices_status_balance
chk_invoices_status_balance.value:
("invoices"."status" = 'emitida' and "invoices"."balance_cents_usd" = "invoices"."total_cents_usd")
        or ("invoices"."status" = 'parcial' and "invoices"."balance_cents_usd" > 0
            and "invoices"."balance_cents_usd" < "invoices"."total_cents_usd")
        or ("invoices"."status" = 'pagada' and "invoices"."balance_cents_usd" = 0)
        or "invoices"."status" in ('borrador', 'anulada')

chk_payments_igtf_consistency.name: chk_payments_igtf_consistency
chk_payments_igtf_consistency.value:
("payments"."applies_igtf" = false and "payments"."igtf_amount_cents_usd" = 0
            and "payments"."igtf_perceived_by" is null)
        or ("payments"."applies_igtf" = true and "payments"."igtf_amount_cents_usd" >= 0
            and "payments"."igtf_perceived_by" in ('clinica', 'banco', 'no_aplica'))

chk_payments_void_reason.name: chk_payments_void_reason
chk_payments_void_reason.value: "payments"."voided_at" is null or "payments"."void_reason" is not null
